candidates.disposition:
Complete owner-content reconciliation under AD5/AD8/AD22/AD32/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 and existing continuation direction. All1469 pre-fold lines were actually read: original user wording/correction, eight backings and twelve placement fields, all25 placed cards, all simple-cheat rows, intake/trope method, ranking provenance, ten equalization modes, nine gift terms,25 opinion ranks, M01–M33/F1–F6/O1–O5, both-winner decisions, C10–C15/UC1–UC20/G1–G7, PS1–PS42/PS7a–f, anime/WN placements/CO1–CO5/N1–N5/A1/NA1–NA5, AL1–AL9, Haruhi/Steins;Gate/memory/history/HS1–HS9, BX1–BX5, CA13 and GP4–GP20 through B133/B285. Earlier selected-range notes are now superseded for content coverage by this full read, not retroactively broadened. Three actual row counts and rank arithmetic are saved in cosmology-table-check-b493.json. No linked report, private chapter, lore evidence or runtime body is read by implication.

Authority and retained alternatives. The user's original correction rejects the invented no-universal-rank ban, retains the fun ranking and asks for real verse equalization. Preserve both hierarchy-based and mechanism-based outcomes where the actual world/scenario supplies them; a genuine universal scale/exceptional cheat is possible, while an institutional rating can merely be a claim. Opinion scores are not source feats or a general resolver. Early tier words and C/PS/UC labels are vocabulary/palette IDs, not a newly accepted universal ladder or mandatory registry schema. The25-rank order is deliberately impression-based rather than sorted by total. M01–M33 cover28 distinct backing combinations plusfive cases; this is table coverage, not foreign matchup proof. The historical70/71 catalogue discrepancy has its later distinct catalogue review and is not a new original-source read here.

Function, carrier and mechanism. Soul/body/item/system/world-law/patron/knowledge/concept labels are starting questions, not automatic winners, transport guarantees or category permission lists. Separate carriage, activation, effect, contact, fuel/support, settlement and persistent result. A changed body may carry a world-law effect after its original trigger ends; an item can need external support; a distributed patron can reach farther than a local law; an intrinsically free or self-supplying power may need no external fuel. A hypothesis that a meta label works everywhere, that a body trait is automatically lost on body change, or that world-law support necessarily stays home needs its actual source/means. Unknown support is a research/implementation gap, not an invented fictional fee, weakness or prohibition. Keep each composite function's separate support rather than flatten a whole cheat into one backing.

Early simple-cheat and collision prose. The statements that scarcity must move, every strong cheat has a weakness rumor, proving a feat updates everyone, or high-layer power must add a different verb are old design suggestions. A genuinely100x/10000x/free duplication/god start can erase its former scarcity, work repeatedly and create no automatic rival, envy, tax or compensating bottleneck. Pushback requires an actual observer/agent/cause. Self-gifting, quotas, extraction attempts, single-use and caps are source/local dials, not exploit-hardening requirements. Exceptional unqualified premises are possible with actual world means; no universal anti-loop/diminishing-return patch follows. A mundane or quiet life remains valid after overwhelming growth. Trope collection/first-session/hour50 suggestions are taste/research ideas rather than three-source or50-hour release gates.

Time, knowledge and numeric scope. M and time-kind examples retain distinct mind-return, recreated world, checkpoint, rate, local reset, branch, patron/owner/cause-edit mechanisms. Nested domain size, earlier anchors and reset scars are possible resolver choices, not compulsory precedence or universally readable evidence. Removed causes can entirely avert an event; a named convergence/fixed beat requires the world's actual law, not franchise familiarity or a generator's preferred plot. Foreknowledge may remain accurate when its relevant causes remain; intervention is not an automatic accuracy tax. Reliable exact prophecy is possible through real means. Seed/save restoration and supernatural rewind are separate; native accidental duplicate grants differ from deliberately supported duplication. UC12's engine-float/overflow fiction needs safe numeric representation and a chosen mechanic, not actual accidental NaN/Infinity, data loss or an extra forced prestige. Higher/lower clock rates and catch-up must follow the selected clocks rather than a generic layer tick.

Observation and ratings. A real event, source statement, analyst inference, institution's scale, witness account, retained record and reader/player perspective remain distinct. Truth versus copies is a useful model when actual consumers need it, not a demand for one giant all-history log or a ban on genuine direct measurement/omniscience. Own native actionable quantities retain truthful views under AD8; a rating board with insufficient evidence can be wrong without making the application's real save/stock feedback deceptive. A public feat reaches observers through actual perception/transmission, not every NPC by default. A staged failure's true cause and the resulting mistaken account differ. PS7 survival/counter examples are nonexhaustive: a blade or name/role mechanism can reach several layers through its actual scope, and erasing recollection is not automatically erasing an independently supported concept. Institutional consequences require an actual consumer, not just a category name.

Names, gifts and crafting. Registered/given/true/honorific/remembered/magic/hidden names target different records, people and channels. Remembered names can cross with actual minds/records/links; arriving where nobody knew you is not literally the same mechanism as name erasure. Other remote name channels may also be attacked without touching the body. Naming need not dominate, and a public name or glyph is not an automatic binding. Gift/digested/matured/lease/loan/lien/leash/bound-item terms describe actual rights/support/removal; a label cannot guarantee permanence or revocation against every stronger means. In particular the LOTM digestion illustration is not fresh primary proof of irreversible patron independence. AL's recipe/material/fuel/operator model is a reusable analytical palette, not proof every craft requires those exact four fields. Knowledge needs a real carrier, and tools, facilities, actual material properties and operator execution can matter. Stored/alternative/free supplies can make manufacture portable; exchange versus multiplication need not always bill another party or attract attention. Novel/games/wiki/scan fields remain source-qualified rather than forced into universal chemistry.

Source chronology. Keep I/U, remembered wiki-only, scan summaries, shown/stated and reported full-WN reading boundaries explicit. Re:Zero arcs1–4 versus5–10, Toaru/Code Geass wiki/memory, blocked alchemy wiki/no-primary scan and Haruhi/Steins;Gate wiki labels retain their original evidence limits. Later Tensura WN rows and Slime addendum supersede early CO4's exact/absolute EP characterization with a rough in-world estimate. Reported304 chapters/70spot checks are that source task's claim; retaining this report does not certify it anew. Operation on Earth by a matured specific power does not automatically transfer to an early stage, a recipe factory or every counterpart. Corrected naming payers/bonds, independent makers, supported domains, copied memories versus surviving soul and protected observation keep their separate actual mechanisms.

Current continuity and retained growth ideas. BX1–BX5 correctly distinguish exchanged subject, authority/other claims, burden valuation, bundled consequences and committed roll/resource settlement. Profitable supported loops and genuinely broad exchange remain possible without mandatory revenge or arbitrary price; no universal exchange power was selected. CA13's quiet faculty default does not require a talking patron/shop or bar one through appropriate means. GP4–GP20 preserve useful long-life growth, optional alternate lives, companionship, skills, obligations, paused former-life default/portable clocks and coherent old-body return. A fixed reset-count reward cannot be called optional if it dominates every viable growth route; equally, a real world loop may center resets. Actual companions are not memories, counterparts or baggage inventory. Old-body conditioning/injury/reserves, continuing learned change, living transfers, held goods and another person's knowledge/choice need their proper owners. Completed-undelivered work differs from unfinished work. Preview is nonmutating; actual transition and failure/partial-arrival policy must come from the incumbent transaction, not an invented all-world atomicity guarantee. The named continuation symbols were originally inspected for limited seams and do not prove an implemented whole LOTM transition today.

Reopen and proof. Early G1/UC20/G7 one-realm/one-prestige-first suggestions are retired as project gates by later scope direction. Saved Q1/dependency/worker/model/allowance sentences are dated records, not current implementation status, active workers or renewed usage ceilings. Keep detailed hypotheses and GP/BX/PS/AL/UC ideas here, with runtime and source gaps in their existing selected owner. A later useful first shared seam follows AD51/AD52, desktop priority and current campaign order rather than requiring a new global cheat registry, all-world collision engine, full-community survey or repeated source wave. Human review is optional AD42. This full-content pass performs no new primary research, source-code edit/read, gameplay/build/browser/persistence/package/install test, acquisition, worker dispatch or publication.

All1469 pre-fold lines were actually read: original user wording/correction, eight backings and twelve placement fields, all25 placed cards, all simple-cheat rows, intake/trope method, ranking provenance, ten equalization modes, nine gift terms,25 opinion ranks, M01–M33/F1–F6/O1–O5, both-winner decisions, C10–C15/UC1–UC20/G1–G7, PS1–PS42/PS7a–f, anime/WN placements/CO1–CO5/N1–N5/A1/NA1–NA5, AL1–AL9, Haruhi/Steins;Gate/memory/history/HS1–HS9, BX1–BX5, CA13 and GP4–GP20 through B133/B285. Earlier selected-range notes are now superseded for content coverage by this full read, not retroactively broadened. Three actual row counts and rank arithmetic are saved in cosmology-table-check-b493.json. No linked report, private chapter, lore evidence or runtime body is read by implication.

Authority and retained alternatives. The user's original correction rejects the invented no-universal-rank ban, retains the fun ranking and asks for real verse equalization. Preserve both hierarchy-based and mechanism-based outcomes where the actual world/scenario supplies them; a genuine universal scale/exceptional cheat is possible, while an institutional rating can merely be a claim. Opinion scores are not source feats or a general resolver. Early tier words and C/PS/UC labels are vocabulary/palette IDs, not a newly accepted universal ladder or mandatory registry schema. The25-rank order is deliberately impression-based rather than sorted by total. M01–M33 cover28 distinct backing combinations plusfive cases; this is table coverage, not foreign matchup proof. The historical70/71 catalogue discrepancy has its later distinct catalogue review and is not a new original-source read here.

Function, carrier and mechanism. Soul/body/item/system/world-law/patron/knowledge/concept labels are starting questions, not automatic winners, transport guarantees or category permission lists. Separate carriage, activation, effect, contact, fuel/support, settlement and persistent result. A changed body may carry a world-law effect after its original trigger ends; an item can need external support; a distributed patron can reach farther than a local law; an intrinsically free or self-supplying power may need no external fuel. A hypothesis that a meta label works everywhere, that a body trait is automatically lost on body change, or that world-law support necessarily stays home needs its actual source/means. Unknown support is a research/implementation gap, not an invented fictional fee, weakness or prohibition. Keep each composite function's separate support rather than flatten a whole cheat into one backing.

Early simple-cheat and collision prose. The statements that scarcity must move, every strong cheat has a weakness rumor, proving a feat updates everyone, or high-layer power must add a different verb are old design suggestions. A genuinely100x/10000x/free duplication/god start can erase its former scarcity, work repeatedly and create no automatic rival, envy, tax or compensating bottleneck. Pushback requires an actual observer/agent/cause. Self-gifting, quotas, extraction attempts, single-use and caps are source/local dials, not exploit-hardening requirements. Exceptional unqualified premises are possible with actual world means; no universal anti-loop/diminishing-return patch follows. A mundane or quiet life remains valid after overwhelming growth. Trope collection/first-session/hour50 suggestions are taste/research ideas rather than three-source or50-hour release gates.

Time, knowledge and numeric scope. M and time-kind examples retain distinct mind-return, recreated world, checkpoint, rate, local reset, branch, patron/owner/cause-edit mechanisms. Nested domain size, earlier anchors and reset scars are possible resolver choices, not compulsory precedence or universally readable evidence. Removed causes can entirely avert an event; a named convergence/fixed beat requires the world's actual law, not franchise familiarity or a generator's preferred plot. Foreknowledge may remain accurate when its relevant causes remain; intervention is not an automatic accuracy tax. Reliable exact prophecy is possible through real means. Seed/save restoration and supernatural rewind are separate; native accidental duplicate grants differ from deliberately supported duplication. UC12's engine-float/overflow fiction needs safe numeric representation and a chosen mechanic, not actual accidental NaN/Infinity, data loss or an extra forced prestige. Higher/lower clock rates and catch-up must follow the selected clocks rather than a generic layer tick.

Observation and ratings. A real event, source statement, analyst inference, institution's scale, witness account, retained record and reader/player perspective remain distinct. Truth versus copies is a useful model when actual consumers need it, not a demand for one giant all-history log or a ban on genuine direct measurement/omniscience. Own native actionable quantities retain truthful views under AD8; a rating board with insufficient evidence can be wrong without making the application's real save/stock feedback deceptive. A public feat reaches observers through actual perception/transmission, not every NPC by default. A staged failure's true cause and the resulting mistaken account differ. PS7 survival/counter examples are nonexhaustive: a blade or name/role mechanism can reach several layers through its actual scope, and erasing recollection is not automatically erasing an independently supported concept. Institutional consequences require an actual consumer, not just a category name.

Names, gifts and crafting. Registered/given/true/honorific/remembered/magic/hidden names target different records, people and channels. Remembered names can cross with actual minds/records/links; arriving where nobody knew you is not literally the same mechanism as name erasure. Other remote name channels may also be attacked without touching the body. Naming need not dominate, and a public name or glyph is not an automatic binding. Gift/digested/matured/lease/loan/lien/leash/bound-item terms describe actual rights/support/removal; a label cannot guarantee permanence or revocation against every stronger means. In particular the LOTM digestion illustration is not fresh primary proof of irreversible patron independence. AL's recipe/material/fuel/operator model is a reusable analytical palette, not proof every craft requires those exact four fields. Knowledge needs a real carrier, and tools, facilities, actual material properties and operator execution can matter. Stored/alternative/free supplies can make manufacture portable; exchange versus multiplication need not always bill another party or attract attention. Novel/games/wiki/scan fields remain source-qualified rather than forced into universal chemistry.

Source chronology. Keep I/U, remembered wiki-only, scan summaries, shown/stated and reported full-WN reading boundaries explicit. Re:Zero arcs1–4 versus5–10, Toaru/Code Geass wiki/memory, blocked alchemy wiki/no-primary scan and Haruhi/Steins;Gate wiki labels retain their original evidence limits. Later Tensura WN rows and Slime addendum supersede early CO4's exact/absolute EP characterization with a rough in-world estimate. Reported304 chapters/70spot checks are that source task's claim; retaining this report does not certify it anew. Operation on Earth by a matured specific power does not automatically transfer to an early stage, a recipe factory or every counterpart. Corrected naming payers/bonds, independent makers, supported domains, copied memories versus surviving soul and protected observation keep their separate actual mechanisms.

Current continuity and retained growth ideas. BX1–BX5 correctly distinguish exchanged subject, authority/other claims, burden valuation, bundled consequences and committed roll/resource settlement. Profitable supported loops and genuinely broad exchange remain possible without mandatory revenge or arbitrary price; no universal exchange power was selected. CA13's quiet faculty default does not require a talking patron/shop or bar one through appropriate means. GP4–GP20 preserve useful long-life growth, optional alternate lives, companionship, skills, obligations, paused former-life default/portable clocks and coherent old-body return. A fixed reset-count reward cannot be called optional if it dominates every viable growth route; equally, a real world loop may center resets. Actual companions are not memories, counterparts or baggage inventory. Old-body conditioning/injury/reserves, continuing learned change, living transfers, held goods and another person's knowledge/choice need their proper owners. Completed-undelivered work differs from unfinished work. Preview is nonmutating; actual transition and failure/partial-arrival policy must come from the incumbent transaction, not an invented all-world atomicity guarantee. The named continuation symbols were originally inspected for limited seams and do not prove an implemented whole LOTM transition today.

Reopen and proof. Early G1/UC20/G7 one-realm/one-prestige-first suggestions are retired as project gates by later scope direction. Saved Q1/dependency/worker/model/allowance sentences are dated records, not current implementation status, active workers or renewed usage ceilings. Keep detailed hypotheses and GP/BX/PS/AL/UC ideas here, with runtime and source gaps in their existing selected owner. A later useful first shared seam follows AD51/AD52, desktop priority and current campaign order rather than requiring a new global cheat registry, all-world collision engine, full-community survey or repeated source wave. Human review is optional AD42. This full-content pass performs no new primary research, source-code edit/read, gameplay/build/browser/persistence/package/install test, acquisition, worker dispatch or publication.

Full owner-content reconciliation under AD5/AD8/AD10–AD20/AD22/AD29/AD32/AD36/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52. All1712 pre-fold lines were read in consecutive150-line slices through1650 and final62. This covers49 initial family rows,13 numbered player-mechanic cards, AQ1–AQ14, US1–US6/ST11–ST17, SW/UP/RS/WR/LB/CT, S1/S1P/S1U/S1V/S1S, AW/DM/S1D/QG/QT/PT/SC/IN/GL, MN/ML/MI/ME/MW/OS, PF/TR/CA/FR/SL/LA/PE/LE, SH1–SH26/OV/SE/II, CSW/AB/LW and A suggestions, all AUDIT/R1/W4/W5/TE/MX/LQ/IA/AB returns, IM1–IM46/D4/G1 and B7/B121/B132/B136/B396 folds. Family/card counts are checked in library-table-check-b499.json; aliases/source mappings are not independent ready implementations. Earlier selected-range notes are superseded for coverage by this actual full read, not retroactively enlarged. No linked private/source/code/report body is credited as newly read.

Authority and current scope. Preserve the user's cheat-as-gameplay/library interest, actual title/rule-target direction, optional start/rarity questions and all later source-local decisions separately from agent proposals. Early first-three-card, C0–C6, CH1-first, stage1-first, two-users-before-seam and BUILD NEXT sequences are historical suggestions. Current PROJECT lead-first work, deferred wider cheat work and heirs as distinct starts govern. AD51 allows the first useful shared seam; expected future consumers are not implemented users and no giant universal card/fact/message engine is required first. AD52 supports long-play compression through actual owners, not a script that skips unpaid effects. The illustrative module/table schemas, old main line counts and source observations are not current architectural authority.

Library cards and new loops. Every initial family and later CT/SH/player card stays a usable palette without requiring every cheat to add a screen, points, new resource, tell, counter, cost or progression arc. Quiet passives, active-at-birth, fixed, fully understood and overwhelmingly effective powers remain possible. Their users can develop new purposes, uses, relationships or combinations while power stays fixed. Ordinary maps, inventory, known records, save controls and truthful actionable UI need not be locked behind an extraordinary ability. A supernatural preview, private feeling, hidden-property read, genuine rewind or exact future needs its actual mechanism/consumer. Losing a source need not erase independently retained knowledge, body change, property or every loop it helped establish.

Enemies and consequences. Same-family policy is not identical desire or a mandatory enemy progression schedule. A regressor need not keep retrying until victory, every clone need not have one core, and a diviner may genuinely see through randomness if its means support it. An early holder can be overwhelmingly strong; later years/boundaries do not automatically level one up without actual support/time policy. Every reveal/tell/counter/hunter/scar/jealousy/patch/backlash line is a possible local consequence, not compulsory fairness or balancing. A free perfect copier or lucky strategy can remove work and remain legitimate under AD22/AD38. Actual observers, goals, reach and causes govern response. Ordinary enemies and rescue/recruitment possibilities remain available without turning all holders into player-facing puzzles.

Carriers and death. Item drop, soul return, new system host, hereditary bloodline and patron reassignment are alternatives requiring surviving actual carriers/terms, not guaranteed outcomes of their category. A carried design can preserve knowledge without materials/body execution; an account/issuer, physical book, institution's rights and a soul are different owners. A backup/profile/player seed is not automatically a character faculty. An heir is a distinct person unless a real selected mechanism carries the continuing self. Knowledge, conditioning, aptitude, reserves, held items, debt, rights and another actor's memory must not be copied as one whole bundle. A real world-deed effect may remain local or propagate through a supported link; it is not necessarily known to everyone. Old one-anchor, day, quota/slot and recursion limits are source/local dials rather than global once-only rules.

Thirteen player-mechanic examples. Keep Echo Anchor's reset scope/order, Furnace's actual routine/time-bank versus real absence, Compact's surviving estate/claims, Pattern Book's learned design versus execution, Cartographer's layout/knowledge, Rebirth Ledger's selected accounting, Instinct's real memory/body carrier, Habit's learned routine, Steward's actual event influence, Dice's committed result, Hall's distinct selves and Deeds' true recipient/world state separate. These cards need not all be costly, smaller than undo-everything, non-social, capped, vulnerable or restricted to a weak first form. Source-derived daily/offline figures remain historical game observations, not fresh product specs or YAIR defaults. Hour50 tests and meaningful-ordinary-work wishes are design taste, not universal acceptance gates or reasons to weaken a genuine powerful premise.

Equivalence Ledger. The stated25% deposit/withdraw spread yields0.75/1.25=60% buying power on the same tariff before rounding, but actual market/credit cycles and zero-fee routes are not proven by a recipe DAG. B121 already qualifies cannot-mint and always-worse-than-merchant claims. Issuer tariff versus actual market value, emitted goods versus finite stock, learned path versus actual sample/recipe, quality/identity/recognition and frozen quote compatibility remain concrete gaps. A book loss or issuer border does not automatically destroy an independently retained account. Its default rounding/no-splitting-gain, refusals and fees are selected candidate mechanics, not universal anti-profit/exchange restrictions. No anchor/pricing source data or spike code was reread here.

Starts and world-relative standing. The library's US/ST/RS8 and progression-guard rows were agent responses to a progression concern, not a ban on strong first-life/random/unlocked starts or on skipping redundant work with real means. Unlock, dormant, weak, costed, fully effective, cheat-free and creative routes remain different possibilities; AQ1's old first-build label is not today's queue. World-law/common/rare/forbidden/cheat standing separates baseline, prevalence, actual strength, social law and personal advantage. WR8's blanket no-universal-rank line conflicts with the user's retained ranking/equalization direction; corrected locally with old wording preserved. Genuine absolute scales and rank conversion can exist when the selected cosmology supplies them. Common powers can still be regulated, rare ones unnoticed, and travel may preserve their function rather than necessarily recalibrating them.

Information and disclosure. Preserve the later return corrections over early OV3/II2/SE4/AB6: precision, depth, interpretation, freshness and forecast are separate axes; retained historical reading keeps value/time/basis rather than live remote truth. Own native quantities remain truthful under AD8, while an actual lying or limited in-world system can have a distinct attributed account. Unknown counts/silhouettes and error/tooltip/ARIA/sort/price/ID leaks need a real discovery means; redacted text alone is insufficient. A peek does not advance draws, but saved seed/stream alone is not the complete future—eligible actions, state and draw order still matter. Real exact prophecy remains possible through its actual law. Source/card/evidence tags do not grant omniscience, current knowledge or all-body authority.

Quest, point and voice proposals. Real native progress, particular system objectives, offers, completion, manual/auto claim, durable grant and displayed receipt are distinct. No mandatory daily board, point cap, reroll tax, harsh attendance/expiry, forced chores or information-only early reward follows. A world can intentionally reward both an ordinary request and a system objective through separate real issuers; accidental double settlement is different. A cruel/deceptive fictional system can offer a trap while the application's actual commitments/stock/save feedback remains accurate. Quiet days, snooze, no guilt, settings and steady known targets remain useful examples. CA13 quiet-base direction does not require an evolving talking character, patron agenda, shop or staged temperament. Fulfilled old work, newly repeated work and already-done offers need their actual identity/baseline rather than a universal no-retroactivity rule.

Persistence, presentation and compaction. Commit-before-reveal, failed-write nonpublication, meaningful quote revalidation, one-owner claim identity, ordinary support-loss and genuine receipt are reusable distinctions, not a new universal phase scheduler or extra full suite. Seed/index alone may not preserve changed board definitions or old content revision; retain consequential admitted terms/results under the actual versioned owner. FR1/FR3 quarantine/reset are old candidate policies; later records preserve opaque raw entries and distinguish strict import/active card/unsupported envelope instead of silently resetting earned progress. No blanket permissive load, migration or new top-level quarantine is selected by this review. Backups retain restoring truth; human share summaries redact appropriately. Protect sealed output without unsolicited obfuscation/anti-cheat hardening of private user storage. Collapsed rendering can be cheap without pausing genuine hidden simulation. Clock/tick counts, world days, absence and banked time are not interchangeable.

Micro and comic choices. MN rounding/unit/source agreement, meaningful have/need, readable long terms, stable subject/focus, explicit Stop, no-spend preview and narrow live announcements remain useful. Do not move a pending click/key repeat to a new claim merely because a row reorders. Theme, plain voice, animation/chime and exact fixed string/line sizes are contextual dials under current desktop rules, not a mandate for every skin. ML retained first message/daily summaries do not replace consequential identity/terms with counts. II/AB's single stack, shared redactor and no-scan suggestions need the real existing consumer; an old dependency map is not a new framework gate. Retcon/sliding-time/status-quo/plot bars are possible declared comic mechanisms, not compulsory canon repair, universal metadata truth or automatic erasure of previous obligations. Changed physical truth versus retained observation needs its actual memory policy; no return/death prediction or compensation is granted by a show-card name.

Later reported implementation chronology. The October14 return table narrows many early new-build proposals, while D4/G1 reports bounded native delivery for quiet insight, optional finite quest system, carcass appraisal, loot-call Dice, visible-foe Ledger, finite Habit, RF1 rehearsal, readable Pattern Book, estate Compact, retained Freshness and OD4/TBANK Furnace. These supersede early blanket no-hook/no-holder/no-carry/no-rematch/no-offline-policy statements at their reported identities. They do not implement all49 families/324-or326 overlapping inventory rows; the326/13-family reconciliation is a different later inventory snapshot, not326 ready cards. RF1 rehearsed opening is not arbitrary enemy timeline rewind. Appraisal cannot silently lower a better reading; retained time is not re-observation. Logged receipt eviction cannot own or revoke a durable keyed result. Local module reserves differ from enduring learned development and actual target-snapshot stock. Existing continuation owners, not a duplicate card reset engine, perform boundary transitions.

Remaining gaps and proof. D4's unused overlay/NPC families, broader share-summary redactor, dev inspector and source-specific PC variants retain their selected source/policy/consumer questions. B7's inspected applyStartGrants source wiring is not an earned ring-elder/unreliable-voice/native-persistence route; IM36 dormant code need not activate during a deferred task. B132/B136/B396 preserve later corrections and optional powerful/carrier routes. Full legacy library reading does not renew the original source inspections,26 RF1 tests, browser/heir/import results or failed-full/targeted-repair gate, and no current code/build/installer/save artifact was inspected. Current runtime claims need their real producers/state/consumers and AD36/AD43 proof, with human review optional AD42. Keep all useful alternatives here, reopen a selected actual world/consumer seam under current direction, and add no new worker, source wave, gameplay/schema/UI implementation, commit or publication from this document reconciliation.

A sample, a dormant template, an expressed organ, learned coordination, taught knowledge, a soul faculty and an institutional title are distinct carriers. A physique can confer a powerful complete function without a balancing flaw, compulsory training or weak starting stage. G2's original gene-thief and source-specific Warhammer candidate remain different: the bounded official introduction/retrospective does not establish arbitrary gene looting, a complete era/lifecycle or psychic control model. No fresh canon, medical or biological claim is verified here.

PH/SG/AG/LQ and G19/G24/G25 separate physiology, reproductive role, identity, presentation, address, registry claim and cultural expectations. The old bio.gender migration/default species assignment and race/height multiplier proposal are not a selected migration or proof those old sources are unchanged. Their effects need actual consumers and an explicit compatibility decision. SG11 dimorphism, AG maturity and ordinary-extreme physiology remain local/reference-qualified examples, not claims that identity determines capacity or a universal real-world medical simulation. Body realism and harshness are different dials. Different bodies can use aids or other means without compulsory cure; a learned skill may remain useful across a body change even when a particular movement needs adaptation. Sex/gender/attraction, NPC agency and adult-person romance follow their actual owners rather than a global player filter. Small characteristics can be texture without a modifier, and silence about a quirk does not prove its absence.

BD/CL/BP/MX, G30 and RL keep ancestry, actual faculty, office, family claim, knowledge, bequest and continued self separate. The old first-prestige gate is retired, and G30 is not thereby implemented or selected. The later B107 correction acknowledges card-specific carryCheats and estate/history owners, qualifying blanket no-faculty-carry statements without claiming arbitrary bloodline/soul transfer. B3 offers/coefficient/caps are illustrative. Strong inherited or mixed faculties need no forced conflict, concentration decay, impairment, antipathy or population takeover. BP's heading “only a bloodline” names these examples, not a ban on another mechanism producing the same function. Biological inheritance does not silently carry learned mastery, allegiance, every ancestor's memory, property or consent. Clones, descendants, borrowed bodies, avatars and continuing consciousness preserve separate identities. Family likeness and a test are evidence with scope; an institutional certificate is a separate legal consumer.

TR/SB/WR/HI/BM/RP/EV/EM/TM and micro MI–SC retain actual training, recovery, exposure, treatment, resource, clock and state transitions. Old-injury weather, disease detection, heredity, critical windows and other real-world inspirations are design suggestions, not reliable medical facts established by this text. A world can support exact supernatural sensing, complete immunity, clean editing, no detraining or no upkeep; the examples do not require side effects, degeneration, hunger death, regression loss or secrecy tells. LA9's statistics alone do not identify a hidden causal constitution. BSR tells do not universally detect lies. A learned clue, current state, stale diagnosis and narrator belief differ; a hidden change cannot reveal itself merely through an unjustified “stale” UI label. Ordinary own-native stats remain accurate under AD8; SI3/CV1/AB12's fuzzy or biased windows require an actual in-world measuring means and do not reclassify native UI as false. Pure flavor cannot assert a fictional event that never happened, but real sensation/texture needs no penalty or new maintenance bar.

SO/GM/GD/MC retain sourcing, access, custody, purity, freshness, compatibility, production and recipient effects as distinct. GM8 already corrects gene-seed to a production-system reference, not one generic host-rewriting organ. GD3 separates clinic complexity, recipient metabolism, active energy and equipped loadout; its budget is local, not a universal genome cap. CV/CA/CC retain reading versus changing, copy/drain/borrow/bestow, stored information versus usable means and world-specific source backing. The example weak/temporary/fuel-limited copied bloodline is one variant, not compulsory weakening of every copy. A potent means can reveal what it actually supports without an automatic error tax or immunity counter. Comic CB13 editorial redating is not bodily stasis; origin retcon, lived memory, current causal truth, mantle and cloned body remain distinct. Source-era/memory disclaimers and later B17/B124 corrections qualify earlier comic generalizations; no exact comic issue or source capture was re-read here.

AB/IM/MT/FD/ST-A–F and OW preserve one truth owner with typed extensions, real action adapters for costs, separate knowledge projections, stable drawn results/revisions, frozen creation inputs, actual full-envelope storage accounting and shared tolerance/source records. They are candidate schemas and historical code observations, not a required new genome engine, mandatory two-implemented-world prerequisite or universal body-record-first program. AD51 qualifies the old “two real consumers” hard gate: design the first useful shared seam with known differences and validate/revise on another actual world. Invalid body.gen/body.modify stream suggestions remain corrected by existing stream families rather than revived. The old10000-person/10MB estimates and32-memory-entry observations are not current measured capacities. About15cards/world/1000cards is explicit speculative volume, not minimum content or authority to launch bulk writers. AD42 makes human samples optional feedback rather than a hard release gate.

**What the final original range adds.** Complete coverage includes direct-recreation/ability-personification frames; all collected/D2/open-decision notes; six installed-source summaries and P-S/P-D/P-NW findings; minigame M1–M3 and zoom ladders; MG01–MG10 plus investing/property contracts; B1/B2 and all15-by5 body/family translation cells, the seven-step tree example and12 additional-body rows; divergence D1–D8; all eight nonhuman-research patterns and strongest-idea rows; P6–P10; the five ongoing supplied-book findings/P29–P32/C1–C29; every final pointer and EL1–EL21 everyday-place round, with EL22–EL41 retained as a pointer rather than a read linked body. **Later material already rejects several early universal claims.** The Er Gen/divergence section explicitly names selection/prompt bias, related author families, MTL/cutoff/missing-source limits and supplied-note rather than fresh-source evidence. It preserves irreversible local tradeoffs, conflicting identities, restoration that can displace another person, successful actions harming infrastructure, knowledge that is erased and ordinary lives that resist becoming resources. A global palette of possible routes is not a promise that every individual can reverse every outcome. Directly granted competence and actual retained sources qualify understand→practice→execute and blanket foreign weakening. D8 preserves jokes, grief, ordinary work and quiet scenes without compulsory progression points. Keep these as qualified source counterexamples and optional design operations, not mandatory harm, coercion, loss or a fresh consensus across independent authors.

The nonhuman research is secondary, with no complete novel read and explicit thin/unverified examples. “The genre's main failure”, always-matching threats, late/costly human avatars, never-empty offline time, one channel ladder and mandatory changing verbs are evaluative proposals, not measured genre laws or new gates. The document corrects its own original instrument-gap finding: TQ70–TQ78 show native tools/slots/required types, forging, opted-in durability, salvage and one loan already existed in the inspected source. TQ62 and the original Village-first proposal are superseded by the scoped IP plan, with IP1–IP3 reported implemented at its dated task receipt. The later table's still-in-progress phrasing is chronology, not a fresh declaration those delivered phases are absent. Current AD44/AD51 and PROJECT govern selection; no new Village/JJK prerequisite wave is dispatched.

Retain product, power container and instrument as complementary roles of one actual item. One item identity/custody owner, actual source/effect owner and read-only instrument profile avoid duplicated condition or capability flags. Fit, precision, hardness, balance, charge, station support and user body can affect different consumers; a grade is not automatically a damage multiplier. The early no-tool/no-verb, every-common-verb-has-improvisation and every-world-becomes-data claims are not universal implementations. Functional substitutions and body/cheat means can supply a role, while an actual unmodeled mechanism remains a gap. Defining fields/rows does not make a new delivery, repair or world law executable. A station is not just a free label, and a loan/service retains real participant, custody, availability and time owners.

The CT/WX/WE/TQ170–TQ189 franchise rows retain their stated MEMORY/W/C/O/P/U source classes and qualifiers. Later corrections refine optional attunement, compatible Ashes, Asauchi versus imprint, exceptional projection and FMA continuity. The public-canon summaries are not fresh paragraph qualification; wand allegiance-by-defeat, every LOTM item side effect, only-soul-keyed loop retention, blade/original-maker restrictions and grimoire/copy absolutes cannot be imported as complete universal source law. An item kind's name need not exclude it from another real role: a sealing object can also be an instrument when a supported action uses it. A borrowed tool can route power without transferring the old wielder's mastery. Body repair, refuel, re-enchant, rebind, identity, social title and institutional paperwork are different outcomes.

Rounds4–5 explicitly replace original-maker-only and hard-input permission lists with actual layer reach, partial outcomes, couplings, matching materials/methods, collaborators, exceptional makers and knowledge claims. Better repairers may exceed the original maker, lesser makers can succeed through fitting means and world-stated absolutes describe ordinary cases with supported exceptions. The source text preserves old wording, including WE2's residual original-smith-only first-job phrase; read it under the later correction. One repaired layer is not full restoration. Diagnosis and visible success can be mistaken; actual unknown damage can still act. A repairer may affect a hidden layer indirectly through a real coupling, so TQ212's cannot-target shorthand must not imply unknown truth is inert. Similar skill/notes do not force every world into a level-comparison formula, and a soul/fit repair need not always take elapsed time if an actual mechanism restores it instantly.

Exception source, provenance, reason and actual scope are useful. Mandatory rising cost, rarity, institutional attention, once-an-era creation or a new all-exception ledger are additional proposals, not required balancing taxes. The final AD22/AD28/AD38 reconciliation explicitly permits extraordinary effectiveness without a compensating penalty. A revelation need not expose the entire exception to every observer; known claims, hidden truth and unbuilt capability remain distinct. An outlier may be repeatable or learnable through its actual means. Direct or lasting creation/conservation exceptions remain original adaptation where they depart from qualified canon, rather than silently rewriting the source. Safe numeric representation, real stock and current-state save integrity still apply.

IP and MT preserve useful selected invariants: opted-out durability behavior, instance identity following existing binding, costs/condition owned once, preview without spending, exact maker/commit snapshot and durable publication. A frozen draw/result does not automatically remove a real continuing tool/support requirement from pending work; the activity's actual contract decides whether later breakage interrupts, changes future stages or leaves already-settled work intact. candidates.disposition:
Full-content review read all190 original lines, including the five insight/zone/encounter/automation/aftermath considerations, first local proof, Hanzi/atlas comparisons, native command bindings, center-menu clarification, timer-driven integration and final source/reference boundaries. The long initial output lost a few words inside the native-progression row; lines70–110 were reread completely before awarding full coverage.

**Resolve the actual direction conflict.** The header and several closing lines still describe one realm/one prestige as the first milestone. That gate was retired by later direction in [USER_VISION](USER_VISION.md) and [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md); it does not constrain current work. The later center-menu clarification in this document already supersedes field-primary composition. Preserve Hanzi as an endorsed visual possibility and atlas as a regional alternative, without treating either as cancelled, compulsory or implemented. Current [site/exploration rules](SITE_AND_EXPLORATION_RULES.md) and [UI rules](UI_RULES.md) govern a selected slice. Old Village/shop/Rat-step human review and736px/320px mockup checks are dated scope, not today's delivery gate or target-desktop proof.

**Keep the useful loop and its distinctions.** Observation, interpretation, executable response and later planning have different causes; a faculty or exceptional method can connect or bypass stages through actual means. A quiet outing can deliver useful resources without a rare monster. Better perception reveals an existing occurrence rather than silently increasing its spawn rate. Sightings, escape, retained clue and victory have different aftermath. A first-discovery reward settles once, while repeat practice may still produce ordinary supported gains. Unknown events can pause the proposed first outing, but that first policy does not impose one stop cadence on every world or automation route. Foreground-only, one active assignment and no new lethal offline loss were proposed first-slice defaults, not permanent limits on supported concurrency or absent-world behavior.

**A display is distinct from a new simulation.** The menu, list, atlas and glyph field can share stable target IDs, legal commands, costs and observer knowledge. Inspecting does not call travel or begin combat; drawn proximity cannot bypass route/access rules. Decorative terrain needs no actor identity or traversable tile. An integrated expedition view can honestly reflect saved pending actions and aftermath without claiming pathfinding, autonomous ecology, wandering encounters or a global offline clock. The scripted conversation scene demonstrated presentation continuity only. The October2 code observations and external comparisons remain historical evidence; no current module absence, native command behavior, reference availability, gameplay test, build, browser or reload was reverified here.

Retain this palette and [engine expansion](ENGINE_EXPANSION.md) for a selected future binding. Real wandering requires its actual gathering/evidence/encounter/return handlers; a map is optional for deeper books or ordinary actions. Reopen with a named changed decision and current-owner inspection, preserving the visual history and scoped acceptance examples.

candidates.review_state: full content reviewed; factual proof scoped to disposition
candidates.disposition:
All1081 pre-fold lines were read in complete1–150,151–300,301–450,451–600,601–750,751–900,901–1081 slices. This includes WC/RN/WW/CR/SU/OV/AB/IM/WX, all four rounds, the full145-row alias table,130 moved rows, moved prose, fidelity tiers and superseded build orders. The current145+130=275 row check and59+37+49/44+11+75 donor arithmetic pass in the task's weaponcraft-alias-check-b479.json; this verifies code-row accounting, not full donor-wording equivalence. No merged-title or prior B56 section receives proxy full-review credit.

**Read the later consolidation.** Round3 corrects the early no-parts/no-live-P2 claims and separates optional wear from the native path. Round4 supersedes the earlier decision to leave donors independent: this is the palette owner, donor stubs preserve d415ef656, and renamed WFI/REV/MKR aliases outrank Round2's loose columns. Archived donor rows101–105 were checked for the ambiguous CS6/CS8 semantics: CS6 hears history or will as psychometry, information about the past; its title does not establish an autonomous talking weapon. CS8 reproduces an inscription on a new carrier, distinct from mere memorization and whole-item/identity duplication. Keep these actual means alongside the canonical CR routes; other aliased extra wording remains in the archived donor and was not all reread here.

**Keep mechanisms and ownership distinct.** Definition/specimen/installed part, material truth, workmanship, geometry, current condition, actor/tool/style fit, actual process and history are independent useful questions. The P6 assembly/pattern and P2 product/knowledge pointers are historical incumbent seams, not a new universal item database or proof every equipped object is a mixture. Reuse the actual touched owner and AD51's first useful shared seam. One maker pipeline is a reuse proposal; different spell, pact, formation, living object or soul laws can need distinct handlers. An open knowledge-store decision in this old palette does not require another competing knowledge owner before useful work. Real craft/work/combat readers decide which data matters; decorative prose and sentimental keepsakes need not invent a stat effect.

**Local dials are not universal restrictions.** Parts, capacities, interference, strength ceilings, weakest-maker caps, obligatory upkeep, weapon discomfort, rune decay, slots, shared budgets and failure costs describe possible mechanisms. A fitting world can have superior/simple numerical gear, infinite capacity, perfect retention, free help, strong independent effects or irreversible harm without a forced counter or balance tax. Information-only design strings differ from an actually supported fabrication/copy faculty. A physical copy can have its own identity; memory, skill, title, owner claim, custody, bond, soul and consent do not all transfer just because a name or pattern does. Inherited gear need not confer skill by itself, while a real teaching/transmission/legacy mechanism can transfer more. Fixed no-loop/symbol budgets protect the selected executor; they do not ban source-supported recursion or unusual results.

**Read and reveal by actual means.** Feelings, counts, glowing hints, search/sort, price, headers, tooltips and accessibility channels can disclose hidden truth. Scope, precision, age, source and uncertainty follow the chosen reader, not a universal low-fidelity ceiling on foreign scripts or divination. A correct result under a mistaken theory preserves observed outcome separately from false explanation. Forecast/rewind/psychometry, copied program and actual sentient advice have different causal contracts. Pure preview does not spend stock or consume a committed draw; a paid fictional appraisal can have its declared cost. Fixed thresholds and proposed F0–F5/RF ladders are not universal world law. Source-qualified knowledge and sealed reveal routes stay with their owners; no raw secret is published here.

**Evidence and current scope.** WW/WQ MEMORY claims remain recall, while Round3's sourced corrections qualify D&D/Fallout/Bleach/Fate/FMA/blueprint simplifications; preserved donor recall does not undo them. Formula names, world-folder/full-book-folder counts, graphs and declared source locators are not primary qualification or implemented powers. B478's making-donor receipt already reports selected rune grammar/ledger consumers beyond the old no-rune snapshots, but lacks a pinned browser build; no current code was inspected here. The three-part knife, braces, blade pair, lamp, ports, registry and maintenance orders remain historical proposals, not a new mandatory queue. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [making rules](MAKING_RULES.md), [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and AD42 optional review govern actual extension. Current desktop sizes/text checks supersede old1366-first gates. A512-boundary causal cap is not a frame-time guarantee; batching wear or migrating/wrapping old items needs explicit semantic compatibility, not the phrase nothing breaks. No original book/game source, private item, current runtime, test/build/browser, personal save, process, acquisition, deletion, commit or push was newly performed.

closeout_amendments.from:
**Where they are weak versus our idle/life-sim**

- Authored, linear, finite: content is one-shot passages, so replay value comes from branching, not systems.
- No ongoing simulation: nothing runs while the player is away, no offline progress, no background NPC schedules.
- Shallow economy: items rarely decay, craft, trade or compound.
- Weak long-horizon pacing: no automation, no throttled energy (Fallen London is the exception) and no many-world meta-progression.
- Fragile persistence across updates, and almost no migration story.
- Twine/ChoiceScript are poor at maps and combat (forum consensus, U).
closeout_amendments.to:
**Limits of this recorded comparison**

The sampled pages emphasize authored passages, branch/stat gates and finite
stories. Their unreported ongoing simulation, offline work, NPC schedules,
economic detail, automation and migration remain unknown unless a row supplies
specific evidence. Those gaps cannot establish engine-wide absence. The recorded
save-loss comments concern particular projects and updates. Fallen London's
action bank is a distinct donor policy, not a missing universal idle feature.
The forum-level map/combat judgment is unverified; a Twine or ChoiceScript tag
alone does not determine those capabilities.

candidates.disposition:
F1: Full220-line content reviewed. The October10 user direction establishes in-play discovery and standard agent sealing; OD13 adds discovery of base-cheat powers. The anatomy, stage machine, minimum-route count, data-only architecture, notebook placement, fairness reviewer, debug switch, randomized-ID storage and suggested proof remain proposals. This document implements no discovery engine and its proposed separate reviewer does not dispatch an agent. Current accepted UI, source, entry, architecture and cheat owners decide their actual selected consumers.

F2: Truth, surface, clue, attributed belief, evidence, action and payoff are useful separate concepts. A suspected reading can be false yet acted upon; detection, identification, understanding, certainty and practical ability need not form a compulsory linear unlock ladder. Effective extraordinary means may reveal a fact immediately under AD8/AD38. The two-route/default-threshold and payoff language should guide fair authored mysteries, not veto a single-means mystery, ambient world texture or a character who can bypass ordinary investigation. P1/P2 already preserve experiments and action before certainty. An unknown label must not invent a prohibition on an otherwise effective method.

F3: Sealing protects surprise in agent/player-facing outputs, including counts, names, route labels, console/errors, exports, descriptions and diffs where they would reveal changed truth. Public source twists remain distinct from changed/randomized private truth. A sealed path convention is not encryption or access control, and a record ID can itself disclose meaning. Use neutral IDs/routes/status in public receipts; do not copy private truth or open previews. A proposed debug unseal control or own-save randomized ID is not evidence that either exists or authority to access private saves. No secret was unsealed by this review.

F4: Discovery scope follows actual observer, life/body/mind carrier, world instance, revision and local time. Remembered player knowledge is not automatic character knowledge, while a genuinely carried memory/journal or faculty can provide a legitimate route without replaying a mandatory riddle. Rumors, stale observations, testimony, public disclosure and changing the cause are different. AD16 pauses inactive worlds by default; natural reveal and moving truths use their real owning clocks. A future source edition may qualify a claim without rerolling committed instance history.

F5: Stable truth, reachable evidence, causal interventions, carried legacies and no accidental duplicate rewards are meaningful selected-slice checks. Randomized truth cannot reroll by ordinary reload; an explicit world-supported change/reset follows its declared contract. The old requirement that every old save begins unnoticed must be reconciled with AR6 and retained evidence rather than blindly erasing existing discovery. AD42 makes human review optional and AD43/AD36 determine relevant proof; the suggested mystery waits on current priority rather than creating another acceptance gate. This review preserves history/proposals and adds no gameplay, migration, native window, source acquisition or secret payload.
